default.notes: A visa from a Kosovo embassy is required — but holders of a valid multi-entry Schengen visa (already used once), or a valid US or UK visa or residence permit, may enter visa-free for up to 15 days.

groups.notes: EU and Schengen-area citizens enter visa-free for up to 90 days within 180 and may enter with a national ID card instead of a passport.
Visa-free for stays of up to 90 days within any 180-day period.
Western Balkans neighbours enter visa-free and may use a national ID card under the regional free-movement agreements.
Gulf state citizens are admitted visa-free for short stays — commonly reported as up to 90 days; confirm with a Kosovo mission before travel.

XK.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for citizens of Kosovo.

RS.notes: Serbian citizens enter visa-free and may use a national ID card under the Western Balkans arrangements. Note that Serbia does not recognise Kosovo’s border points — returning to Serbia after entering Kosovo directly can cause problems at Serbian crossings.
